versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-xhs-viral-mining.
- Enables keyword-based search of public Xiaohongshu (小红书) posts, returning titles, content summaries, author info, interaction stats, and direct links.
- Supports post detail lookup, comment extraction, and creator post monitoring by link.
- Designed for researching topic trends, content analysis, and competitive monitoring on Xiaohongshu.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for all actions; setup instructions and examples included in documentation.
